gloss: to be timid, to flinch, to be daunted

definitions.gloss: to be timid, to flinch, to be daunted, to lose one's nerve
definitions.explanation: To feel intimidated or fearful, causing hesitation or loss of confidence. Often used in negative constructions to describe someone who doesn't back down.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}に{臆|おく}してはいけない。
{彼|かれ}は{臆|おく}することなく、{大勢|おおぜい}の{前|まえ}で{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{主張|しゅちょう}した。
examples.english: Without flinching, he asserted his opinion in front of a large crowd.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}).

CONJUGATION: {サ|さ}{変|へん}{動詞|どうし} (irregular する verb): {臆|おく}しない, {臆|おく}します, {臆|おく}して.

NUANCE: {臆|おく}する is a literary/formal word implying cowardice or losing nerve. It's often used in negative constructions ({臆|おく}せず, {臆|おく}することなく) to describe courage or determination.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {臆|おく}することなく (without flinching)
- {臆|おく}せずに (unflinchingly)
- ～に{臆|おく}する (to be daunted by ~)

RELATED ADJECTIVE: {臆病|おくびょう} (cowardly, timid)

RELATED WORDS:
- {物怖|ものお}じする (to be shy/timid)
- {気後|きおく}れする (to feel intimidated)
- {怯|ひる}む (to flinch, cower)
- {尻込|しりご}みする (to shrink back)
